content.short: Kroma is an Optimistic Rollup with ZK fault proofs, based on OP Stack and utilizing Scroll’s zkEVM.
content.description: Kroma is pursuing a universal ZK Rollup built around the Optimism Bedrock model. At present, the project operates as an Optimistic Rollup that includes ZK fault proofs and relies on a Scroll-based zkEVM. The long-term plan is to migrate to a full ZK Rollup once ZK proof generation becomes more affordable and faster. In the meantime, Kroma aligns with a multi-chain scope, with Ethereum, Multichain, Polkadot, and Polygon zkEVM support, aiming to improve scalability and efficiency as the technology evolves.
